title: Fuzz and property tests: no-panic guarantee and round-trip
description: No-panic corpus: pass random and malformed inputs to decode() and encode(); neither may panic. Round-trip property test: encode with Python oracle output (committed fixtures), decode with Rust -- never use this crate's own encode() as the oracle for its own decode(). The fixtures in tests/fixtures/ are the oracle.
close_reason: no_panic.rs integration test: 30+ corpus items, sweep_lengths 0..=255, all_single_bytes, ramp_256, multipart round-trip. Oracle is Python fixture generator, not self.
